must_catch.item: The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal.
No dollar figure is stated. The rep doesn't know it.
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence.

fails: Decided section asserts that 'After that it was paperwork' is overstated because she raised the missing reference 'twice more before signing'. The transcript only says 'she brought it up twice' and never places those mentions after the value meeting, so this timing claim is invented.
data.notes: The report correctly identifies the CFO's month-end close as the real trigger. It also identifies the value case built from her own data as the turning point, and it keeps both Fiserv's pitch and the dollar figure unknown. It mislabels the rep's 'She let it go' as fact rather than opinion. Its messaging changes never explicitly drop the global/infrastructure opener (M1), and they omit a demo of counter readers landing in the same report; both appear only in the section text.
